r: vasudèva sutaM dèvaM kaMsa cARUra mardanam . dèvakI paramAnandaM kfzRaM vandè jagadgurum ..
atasI puzpa saNkASaM hAra nUpura SòBitam . ratna kaNkaRa kèyUraM kfzRaM vandè jagadgurum ..
kuwilAlaka saMyuktaM pUrRacandra niBAnanam . vilasat kuRqalaDaraM kfzRaM vandè jagadguram ..
mandAra ganDa saMyuktaM cAruhAsaM caturBujam . barhi piYCAva cUqANgaM kfzRaM vande jagadgurum ..
utPulla padmapatrAkzaM nIla jImUta sanniBam . yAdavAnAM SiròratnaM kfzRaM vandè jagadgurum ..
rukmiRI kèli saMyuktaM pItAmbara suSòBitam . avApta tulasI ganDaM kfzRaM vandè jagadgurum ..
gopikAnAM kucadvandva kuMkumANkitavakzasam SrI niketaM mahezvAsaM kfzRaM vande jagadgurum ..
SrIvatsANkaM mahòraskaM vanamAlA virAjitam . SaNKacakra DaraM dèvaM kfzRaM vandè jagadgurum ..
kfzRAzwakamidaM puRyaM prAtarutTAya yaH paWèt . kòwijanma kftaM pApaM sadya eva vinaSyati ..
